title: Kernel Forge：基于LLM的CUDA内核生成与优化智能体框架
summary: Kernel Forge 是一个开源端到端智能体框架，可直接接受未修改的PyTorch模型，利用LLM和蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）自动生成并优化CUDA内核。支持视觉、扩散和LLM工作负载，提供图形界面监控调试。在GB10 GPU上优化14个内核，性能提升1.52倍至2.83倍。
summary_en: Kernel Forge is an open-source end-to-end agent harness that accepts unmodified PyTorch models, uses LLMs and Monte Carlo Tree Search to generate and optimize CUDA kernels. It supports vision, diffusion, and LLM workloads with a GUI for monitoring and debugging. On a GB10 GPU, it optimizes 14 kernels achieving 1.52x to 2.83x speedups over PyTorch eager mode.
